features: 25W boAt Signature Sound: Supercharge your personal soundtrack with a punchy 25W RMS output. Custom-engineered to project iconic boAt Signature Sound, this portable speaker delivers rich low-end bass, crisp vocals, and dynamic clarity that easily fills outdoor spaces and rooms alike.

IPX5 Sweat and Splash Resistance: Take your music everywhere without worrying about water spills or sudden weather shifts. The rugged IPX5-rated housing protects internal drivers against poolside splashes, rain sprinkles, and workout sweat.

Up to 8 Hours of Playtime: Keep your favorite tracks playing continuously through daytime hangouts and evening trips. Supported by an energy-efficient rechargeable battery, it delivers up to 8 hours of uninterrupted playback on a single charge.

Built-in Mic for Handsfree Calling: Take phone calls directly through your speaker without reaching for your device. The high-sensitivity built-in microphone captures clear vocal frequencies, letting you transition smoothly from streaming music to hands-free conversations.

TWS for 2X Power: Double your total audio output by linking two speakers using True Wireless Stereo (TWS) pairing. Wirelessly connect two boAt Stone 510 units together to create a massive 50W RMS soundstage with distinct left and right stereo separation.
